description: SDL 3 for zero-mode C# programs: windows, 2D drawing, keyboard and mouse. Windows programs get SDL's own DLL from the package; Linux and macOS ones link with the SDL 3 installed on the build machine.

An observable conversation model for AI chat user interfaces: turns the streamed updates of any Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient into conversation entries (text, reasoning, tool calls, usage, errors), and runs each turn with stop, timing and token counts.
An AI chat control for Avalonia: streamed replies rendered as Markdown, reasoning, tool calls, per-turn usage, stop and copy, on top of any Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient.
Document validator for Reglet: checks DOCX, XLSX, ODF and PDF files for what Word, Excel, LibreOffice and PDF readers would reject (package structure, ECMA-376 schemas, cross-references).
XLSX (SpreadsheetML, ECMA-376) workbook writer and reader for Reglet.

OpenAPI schemas for F# types serialized with FSharp.SystemTextJson. Schema and document transformers for Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi that cover options, records, unions, tuples, enums and collections.
